decisions: 2026-09-25: no human artist at any stage; the AI makes every stage and the user gives the final visual approval (the user's decision, relayed by the workflow coordinator).

2026-09-25: weapons are separate models attached to hand sockets, never part of a hero body (the user's decision, relayed by the workflow coordinator). Selene gets empty hands and forearms; her signature chassis, the thundercoil_launcher (assets/models/weapons/thundercoil_launcher.glb, two-handed), attaches at weapon_R (and weapon_L). The two floating coil devices the concept draws beside her hands are weapon / VFX, not body: they are cut from the stage-1 input and never modelled on the body (they could become a Thundercoil skin variant later).

2026-09-27: the stage-1 input is the approved front with a verified alpha (references/selene_concept_front_input.png, art/characters/selene/stage1_input.py): the coils cut, and the dark navy ground that birefnet keeps between the hair, the wisps and the crown shards removed by a colour key. A first run on the plain concept (seed 101, kept local in work/first_input/) made the coils ~1 m barrels in depth crossing the cape and fused the crown shards and that ground into a second hair mass (reports/blockout_report.md section 2).

0_concept_reference.notes: Done 2026-09-27 with the user's approved T-pose front (docs/media/playable_characters/selene.png, 1536x1024 on flat dark navy), copied verbatim. Brief, measured palette (15 swatches inside the birefnet mask: the ground is within 2.4 L* of her black bodysuit), readability sheet (the coils masked out) and prompts for the four missing sheets. Side, back, 3/4 and expression are optional and do not block stage 1 or 2 (proposals in brief.md section 7.2; prompts in turnaround_prompts.md).

front.notes: The user-approved front concept (1536x1024 T-pose on flat dark navy #17202A), copied verbatim: a tall slender sorceress, silver-white hair in a high bun with six storm-crystal shards floating round the head, glowing ice-blue eyes, a black high-collared sleeveless bodysuit with gold filigree and a blue diamond gem at the collar, bare arms with lightning-vein tattoos, dark fingerless gauntlets with ice-blue claws, two long outer capes, two hip panels and a pale centre tabard in storm-blue gradients with ragged storm-cloud edges, black leggings, gold-trimmed greaves with cyan glows and pointed sabatons; two floating coil devices beside the hands (weapon / VFX, not body: decisions).

side.notes: Optional. Not supplied; stage 2 takes the depth from the stage-1 blockout and brief.md section 7.2 (capes from the shoulder bows, flat sabaton sole).

back.notes: Optional. Not supplied; proposal: the suit closed at the back with a gold filigree spine line, a wrapped bun, the capes over the back of the legs (brief.md section 7.2 Q4).

expression.notes: Optional. The face is 1-2 px of eye glow at game scale; expressions matter for portraits and the codex only.

palette.notes: Automated measurement of the approved front (15 swatches, shadow/base/highlight; rim/hot/core for the four emissives) inside the birefnet figure mask. A STAND-IN for a painted colour script with lighting and kit states (Static Charge, Heaven's Verdict).

1_blockout.notes: SCULPT REFERENCE ONLY - never shipped, never copied to assets/models/, never rigged. The birefnet mask keeps the whole figure (nothing lost beyond 9 px), but a first run on the plain concept (s101, local in work/first_input/) made the two floating coils ~1 m barrels in depth and fused the ground around the head with the crown shards into a second hair mass, so the input is the front with a verified alpha (coils cut, head ground keyed out). TRELLIS.2 (Pixal3D pruned), 3 seeds (101/202/303) at the user character settings (700k faces, 4096 px), 291-308 s each. s303 picked: the only slim female face with pale skin and eyes and silver-white hair, the concept deep storm-blue cloth (s101/s202 went teal-cyan, the P2-ring colour), five clean clawed fingers, two legs with the tabard and panels free at the knee, span/height 0.961 (concept 0.932), no hole over 1.6 cm. Known defects (reports/blockout_report.md section 6): the bun is a separate mass ~0.2 m behind the head with a hair tail (all seeds), the six crown shards are fused into the hair as side prongs, thick partly fused cloth, no emissive, baked lighting. The seed pick is an engineering judgement; the user visual approval comes at stage 2.

2_production_mesh.notes: Made by AI (no human artist), a Selene variant of the stage-2 chain (tools/blender/gf_hero/s2_selene_*.py): MakeHuman hm08 body fit, capes / panels / tabard as cloth parts, crown shards as separate rigid pieces, empty hands. The user's visual approval stays pending_human.

3_rig.notes: GF_Hero_v1 + x_crown_* shard bones under head_top and cloth chains for the capes, panels and tabard (brief.md section 8).

4_animation.notes: The 24 shared clips re-posed on her proportions + her unique set (brief.md section 8: idle_signature, arc_nova, blink_out / blink_in, heavens_verdict_start / @loop, static_charge, launcher fire poses) + a cloth pass.
